title: SIMMAN 2014 KVLCC2/KCS free-running benchmark data

license.sourceStatement: No explicit dataset license was established from the public workshop landing pages

acquisition.reason: Official SIMMAN 2014 page instructs users to request access; reuse terms and exact primary files must be obtained before ingestion

scientificScope.claimLimit: Supports an optional propeller/rudder/hull model structure cross-check at the published benchmark scale; it is not independent validation of Vehicle B and coefficients must not transfer to Vehicle B's USV parameterization

releaseIsolation.warning: SIMMAN 2020 states that much of the 2008/2014 model-test data was replaced; releases must not be mixed

requiredBeforeImport: Record hull and exact dataset release
Record earth-fixed and body-fixed axis definitions
Record heading, rudder, yaw-rate, force, and moment signs
Record time origin, sampling, propulsion/RPM control, water depth, and initial speed
Record every conversion into the reference-neutral trajectory schema

requiredArtifacts: Official model-test specification and column definitions
